title: fix(i18n): apply object _views translations to view tabs and breadcrumbs
body:
## Reproduction

1. Start HotCRM with `pnpm exec objectstack dev --ui --fresh -p 4057`.
2. Sign in and open a Chinese interface, for example `/crm_opportunity/view/pipeline_kanban`.
3. The i18n endpoint `/api/v1/i18n/translations/zh` returns `crm_opportunity._views.pipeline_kanban.label: 销售流水线` (and the new `stale_opportunities` translation).
4. The console still renders `Sales Pipeline` and `⚠️ Stale Opportunities · Longest in Stage First` in the tab bar, more-views menu, and current-view breadcrumb.

## Expected

All list-view presentation surfaces resolve `objects.{objectName}._views.{viewName}.label` for the active locale, with the metadata label only as fallback.

## Notes

- Object labels, navigation, fields, and much of the surrounding Chinese UI are translated successfully.
- The issue reproduces for pre-existing translations as well as new entries, so it is not a HotCRM translation-data gap.
- HotCRM metadata has been verified to return the expected translation payload.
